description: This file contains the internal class RulesetStandardLibrary, which provides utility functions and actions for endpoint evaluation in the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods for regex matching, URL parsing, attribute extraction, and other helper functions used internally for AWS endpoint/rules processing.
